_comment: LOCAL FALLBACK CACHE for Workflow 2 (Find Peptides). This is NOT a substitute for querying Gene Ontology / UniProt / Human Protein Atlas live; it exists so the workflow degrades honestly when those APIs are unreachable. Every entry is tagged source='curated_local_seed' and requires_verification=true in the output, and no PMIDs are recorded here because inventing citation identifiers would be worse than having none. Gene symbols and UniProt accessions should be confirmed at uniprot.org before use. Extend this file as live retrieval is wired up.

_schema.keywords: match terms, lowercased, substring-matched against the user query
_schema.cell_types: cell types known to perform the process (Cell Ontology IDs where known)
_schema.established_peptides: peptides/proteins with well-established roles; drives the Step 2 short circuit
_schema.candidate_peptides: less-established or context-dependent associations, ranked in Step 3

cell_types.name: Schwann cell
cell_types.relationship: Forms myelin sheath in the peripheral nervous system

cell_types.name: Oligodendrocyte
cell_types.relationship: Forms myelin sheath in the central nervous system

cell_types.name: Oligodendrocyte precursor cell
cell_types.relationship: Differentiates into myelinating oligodendrocytes; target of remyelination strategies

established_peptides.name: Neuregulin-1 type III
established_peptides.rationale: Axonal NRG1 type III signalling through ErbB2/ErbB3 is the principal determinant of Schwann cell myelination and sheath thickness in the PNS.

established_peptides.name: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor
established_peptides.rationale: Promotes myelination via TrkB/p75 signalling; acts on both Schwann cells and oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

established_peptides.name: Insulin-like growth factor 1
established_peptides.rationale: Supports oligodendrocyte survival and myelin protein synthesis; IGF1 loss reduces myelin content.

established_peptides.name: Laminin alpha-2 (laminin-211)
established_peptides.rationale: Laminin-211 in the Schwann cell basal lamina is required for radial sorting of axons and for myelination in the peripheral nervous system. LAMA2 loss-of-function causes merosin-deficient congenital muscular dystrophy with a dysmyelinating peripheral neuropathy, which is the strongest evidence that this is required rather than merely correlated. Note that this is a very large ECM protein, not a peptide: its myelination-relevant activity is distributed across folded domains, so short derived motifs such as IKVAV or YIGSR reproduce adhesion but not the full function.

candidate_peptides.name: Ciliary neurotrophic factor
candidate_peptides.rationale: Supports oligodendrocyte survival and has been investigated in demyelinating models.

candidate_peptides.name: Leukemia inhibitory factor
candidate_peptides.rationale: gp130 cytokine reported to protect oligodendrocytes in demyelination models.

candidate_peptides.name: Myelin basic protein
candidate_peptides.rationale: Structural myelin component rather than a signalling peptide; included because expression is highly specific to myelinating cells.

candidate_peptides.name: Laminin alpha-4 (laminin-411)
candidate_peptides.rationale: Laminin-411 (alpha4-beta1-gamma1) is present in the Schwann cell basal lamina alongside laminin-211 and in vascular basement membranes. Its contribution to myelination is less dominant than laminin-211, which is why it ranks as a candidate rather than established. The A4G peptide series, including A4G47 (VISLYNFREMIL) from the LG3 module, provides short synthetic sequences derived from its G domain that are analysable as peptides.

cell_types.name: Fibroblast
cell_types.relationship: Deposits extracellular matrix and drives contraction

cell_types.name: Endothelial cell
cell_types.relationship: Forms new vasculature supplying the repair site

established_peptides.name: Epidermal growth factor
established_peptides.rationale: Drives keratinocyte proliferation and migration; long-established in re-epithelialisation.

established_peptides.name: Vascular endothelial growth factor A
established_peptides.rationale: Principal angiogenic signal supplying the granulation tissue.

candidate_peptides.name: Thymosin beta-4
candidate_peptides.rationale: Actin-sequestering peptide reported to accelerate wound closure and promote angiogenesis.

candidate_peptides.name: BPC-157
candidate_peptides.rationale: Synthetic pentadecapeptide derived from a gastric juice protein fragment. Widely reported in rodent repair models; human clinical evidence is limited, so this ranks as a candidate rather than an established answer.

cell_types.name: Endothelial cell
cell_types.relationship: Proliferates and migrates to form new vessels

established_peptides.name: Vascular endothelial growth factor A
established_peptides.rationale: Canonical pro-angiogenic factor acting through VEGFR2.

established_peptides.name: Fibroblast growth factor 2
established_peptides.rationale: Potent endothelial mitogen, long established in angiogenesis.

candidate_peptides.name: Angiopoietin-1
candidate_peptides.rationale: Tie2 ligand promoting vessel maturation and stability rather than sprouting.

cell_types.name: Neutrophil
cell_types.relationship: Stores and releases antimicrobial peptides from granules

cell_types.name: Paneth cell
cell_types.relationship: Secretes defensins into the intestinal crypt

cell_types.name: Keratinocyte
cell_types.relationship: Produces cathelicidin and beta-defensins at the epithelial barrier

established_peptides.name: Cathelicidin LL-37
established_peptides.rationale: The sole human cathelicidin; broad-spectrum membrane-disrupting antimicrobial peptide.

established_peptides.name: Human beta-defensin 2
established_peptides.rationale: Inducible epithelial defensin active against Gram-negative bacteria.

candidate_peptides.name: Hepcidin
candidate_peptides.rationale: Primarily an iron-regulatory hormone; antimicrobial activity is secondary and largely indirect via iron restriction.

cell_types.name: Enteroendocrine L cell
cell_types.relationship: Secretes GLP-1 and PYY in response to nutrient intake

cell_types.name: Pancreatic beta cell
cell_types.relationship: Target of incretin signalling; secretes insulin

cell_types.name: Adipocyte
cell_types.relationship: Secretes leptin in proportion to fat mass

established_peptides.name: Glucagon-like peptide-1
established_peptides.rationale: Incretin driving glucose-dependent insulin secretion and satiety; the basis of an established drug class.

established_peptides.name: Leptin
established_peptides.rationale: Adipose-derived satiety signal acting on hypothalamic circuits.

candidate_peptides.name: Peptide YY
candidate_peptides.rationale: Co-secreted with GLP-1; reduces food intake via Y2 receptor signalling.

candidate_peptides.name: Ghrelin
candidate_peptides.rationale: Orexigenic rather than anorexigenic; relevant to appetite regulation but with the opposite sign of effect.
